notes: **Atom:** the smallest unit of an element that retains its chemical identity. Dalton's atomic theory postulates that all matter is made of atoms.
**Molecule:** the smallest unit of a compound that retains its chemical identity. Molecules can be elemental ($O_2$) or compound ($H_2O$).
**Atomic mass unit:** $1\,\text{u} = 1/12$ the mass of a $^{12}$C atom $= 1.6605 \times 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$.
**Relative atomic mass $A_r$:** average mass of atoms of an element relative to 1/12 mass of carbon-12.
**Relative molecular mass $M_r$:** sum of relative atomic masses of all atoms in a molecule.
**Molecular formula:** actual number of atoms of each element in a molecule. Example: $C_6H_{12}O_6$ for glucose.
**Empirical formula:** simplest whole-number ratio of atoms. Example: empirical formula of glucose is $CH_2O$.
**Radical:** a group of atoms that behaves as a single unit in chemical reactions, carrying a positive or negative charge.
